name.description: credential delete: the credential id; proxy update: the proxy id; classic_device update or delete: the device name; schedule update or delete: the schedule id; cloud_account rotate, test or delete: the account name; controller_setup or mist_setup update or delete: the setup name

definition.description: the non-secret body; see the SKILL.md table. A secret-looking field is refused

secret_file.description: path of a file (mode 600) holding the secret, or a JSON object of named secrets for SNMP v3

secret_env.description: name of an environment variable holding the secret (instead of secret_file)

confirm.description: credential delete: the exact credential id; classic_device delete: the device name; jump_server delete: the jump server id; rapid7_source delete: the source name; schedule delete: the schedule id; cloud_account delete: the account name; controller_setup or mist_setup delete: the setup name
